pages.transcription:
C. BIRMAN                                           14, RUE LACRETELLE XVe
LICENCIÉE EN DROIT XXXXXXXXXXXXXX                   TÉL: VAUGIRARD 54-38
CONSEIL JURIDIQUE DE LA LÉGATION D'AUTRICHE
À PARIS

DE 10 À 12 H. SAUF SAMEDI
ET SUR RENDEZ-VOUS                                  Paris, 17th November 1938.


Stefan ZWEIG, Esq.,
49, Hallam Street
London W.1.

Dear Sir,

        as the lawyer of Mrs. Friderike M. ZWEIG, 218, rue de
Grenelle, Paris (7e), I herewith ask you to do all the necessary
steps in order to assure that the obligations due to my client
and resulting from the estate of late Mrs. Ida ZWEIG, your mother,
may be entirely fulfilled.

        You are well aware and agree that your mother promised
to my client that after her death half of your mother's jewels will
become the propriety of Mrs. Friderike Zweig. According to your
information, which my client and myself think reliable, and due
to political circumstances the pre-mentioned estate had not yet
been liquidated, the jewels and other assets in Austria having
been confiscated by local authorities.

        I am obliged to point out, that I cannot agree that my
client be disadvantaged by these facts. As an other part of this
same estate is outside of Austria and Germany, and thus available,
I have to ask you to indemnify my client from this part of the
estate in cash money, if she has not got her part of jewels at the
date of the liquidation of the estate.

        I herewith inform you of that claim of my client before
any repartition to the heirs takes place and ask you as one of the
trustees and executors to assert this claim. In case you would not
be willing to do so, I should be obliged to advise my client to
safeguard her rights by all other means possible.

        Hoping to hear from you in this respect,
        Yours faithfully,

                                            C. Birman
pages.notes: Typoskript auf Briefpapier mit Briefkopf. Die Unterschrift ist handschriftlich. Das Wort 'assets' wurde im Original als 'assetts' geschrieben, 'and' statt 'end' (Zeile 13) wurde als 'and' transkribiert, da es sich um einen Tippfehler im Original handelt.
Rückseite des Dokuments, leer (Durchschlag/Durchdruck des Textes der Vorderseite sichtbar).
